title: Whispers from the Neighbors: Rethinking Caption Consensus as Inference-Time Evidence for Vision-Language Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.33798v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An image is rarely described only once. Retrieval benchmarks and many collections attach several captions to each picture, yet dual encoders still judge every image-caption pair in isolation. We ask what these neighboring captions contribute when a frozen encoder consults them at inference time. Fusing image similarity with similarity to an image's own captions improves text-to-image R@1 by 3.4 to 16.8 points across nine frozen encoders when the captions come from the same annotators as the queries. The gain falls to 1.9 to 7.2 points when an off-the-shelf captioner writes them, and to at most one point when they come from a different annotation source; a paraphrase-trained text encoder strengthens the text side further. A natural refinement, scoring the part of the image that the captions leave unexplained, appears to add much more under a leave-one-out evaluation. translated_title: 邻居的低语：重新思考描述共识作为视觉-语言检索的推理时证据
translated_abstract: 一幅图像很少只被描述一次。检索基准和许多数据集为每张图片附加了多个描述，然而双编码器仍然孤立地判断每一个图像-描述对。我们探究当冻结的编码器在推理时参考这些相邻描述时，它们能带来什么贡献。将图像相似度与图像自身描述的相似度进行融合，当描述来自与查询相同的标注者时，可在九个冻结编码器上将文本到图像检索的R@1提升3.4至16.8个百分点。当描述由现成的描述生成器生成时，增益降至1.9至7.2个百分点；而当描述来自不同的标注来源时，增益最多只有一个百分点；使用释义训练的文本编码器可进一步增强文本侧的性能。一种自然的改进方法——对图像中描述未能解释的部分进行评分——在留一法评估下似乎能带来更大的提升。我们证明这一优势之所以产生，是因为正确候选者的…
tldr: 该论文提出在推理时将同一图像的相邻描述共识作为证据融合进冻结双编码器的视觉-语言检索中，在同源标注描述条件下可将文本到图像检索R@1提升3.4至16.8个百分点。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes leveraging caption consensus—the neighboring captions of the same image—as inference-time evidence fused into frozen dual-encoder vision-language retrieval, improving text-to-image R@1 by 3.4 to 16.8 points when captions come from the same annotators as the queries.
